title: Trading Journal API
verified: Routes checked against export_endpoints output (117 unique). Request bodies and filter names checked against the serializer and filter code.

conventions.auth: JWT: Authorization: Bearer <access>. Access 15 min (8 h in DEBUG), refresh 7 days; refresh tokens die on password change.
conventions.money: Decimal values are strings with 2 decimals.
conventions.times: UTC ISO 8601; day boundaries use the user's timezone.
conventions.errors: JSON; validation errors keyed by field (400). 401 bad/expired token, 403 email_not_verified, 404 other users' objects, 429 throttled.
conventions.request_id: Every response carries X-Request-ID; quote it in bug reports.

Replace the backup codes with 10 new ones. Needs the password and a current code. The old ones stop working.
Turn two-factor off. Needs the password and a current code (or a backup code). Forgets remembered devices.
Step 2: prove the app works by sending a current code. Returns 10 backup codes, shown only this once.

Start changing the account email. A link goes to the new address, and nothing changes until it is opened.

Sign in with email and password. 403 until the email is verified. Two-factor users get a challenge for /login/2fa/ unless a remembered device_token is sent.
endpoints.notes: 403 code email_not_verified until verified. 2FA users get {two_factor_required:true, challenge} instead of tokens. Success returns {access, refresh}.

endpoints.summary: Second step of signing in: the challenge from the first step plus a code. Send remember_device to skip the code on this device for a while.
